sentences.en: That might be the most painful experience in my life.
sentences.zh: 那可能是我一生中最痛苦的经历。

sentences.en: Recently my haemorrhoids, which I've had from before, are painful.
sentences.zh: 最近我的痔疮又开始疼了，之前就有了这个毛病。

sentences.en: The loss of her father was very painful for her.
sentences.zh: 她父亲去世给她带来了极大的痛苦。

senses.zh: 痛苦的,（肉体）疼的,费力的，（工作）困难的,讨厌的，使人厌烦的
